name: jobscan
description: Drive the JobScan AI desktop app from Codex: check its status, start its six safe steps, relay your requests, and hear what happens. Numbers and labels only; no job-posting text reaches the session.

interface.shortDescription: Drive the JobScan AI desktop app
interface.longDescription: Lets a Codex session drive JobScan AI on this computer: read where it is, start a database rebuild, find jobs, find more, rate them or stop the auto-apply loop, and hear what happens as numbers and labels. Applying, choosing jobs and settings stay in JobScan's window.
defaultPrompt: Use $jobscan to tell me where JobScan stands.
